categories.title: 布局与空间
categories.applicability: Rendered layout, scroll containers or overlays exist
categories.limits: Project defines intentional overlap, clipping and horizontal scrolling; intersecting rectangles alone do not prove obstruction.

categories.title: 视觉秩序与一致性
categories.applicability: Visual hierarchy, components or design tokens affect the task
categories.limits: Use project tokens and approved baseline; no global whitespace ratio or aesthetic pass algorithm. DTCG migration is optional.

categories.title: 文字、图标与内容表达
categories.applicability: Task has visible text, icons, images or status messages
categories.limits: Static alt presence does not establish meaningful content; truncation needs project permission and access to full text.

categories.title: 尺寸、缩放与国际化
categories.applicability: Supported devices, zoom, system text sizes or languages change rendering
categories.limits: Only declared targets count; narrow browser viewport does not prove touch, soft keyboard, safe areas or a real mobile device.

categories.title: 语义与辅助技术
categories.applicability: User-facing semantic controls or non-text information exist
categories.limits: Reuse mature audits for applicable rules; automatic scans and attribute presence do not prove full accessibility compliance.

categories.title: 键盘与焦点
categories.applicability: Supported platform has keyboard, switch or focus navigation
categories.limits: Actual key events, order, visibility and return focus required; static tabindex alone does not prove keyboard task completion.

categories.title: 指针、触摸与手势
categories.applicability: Project supports click, pointer, touch, drag or gestures
categories.limits: Target thresholds retain applicable standard exceptions; pointer hit tests do not prove real device gestures.

categories.title: 输入、表单与校验
categories.applicability: Task accepts user input, uploads or editable fields
categories.limits: Business ranges, IME, paste, defaults and correction paths belong to project; schema validation does not replace input.

categories.title: 控件状态完整性
categories.applicability: Controls have applicable loading, empty, error, disabled, selected or expanded states
categories.limits: Record only real applicable states; intentionally disabled or hidden controls are not universally errors.

categories.title: 导航、定位与退出
categories.applicability: Task changes pages, routes, selections or has exit and unsaved state
categories.limits: Use project deep-link, back, refresh and dirty-state expectations; temporary trial input is not automatically unsaved business data.

categories.title: 异步与状态一致性
categories.applicability: Task has asynchronous work, pending requests, cancellation or repeat actions
categories.limits: Wait for actual state and check race, stale responses and side effects; fixed sleep and displayed success cannot prove completion.

categories.title: 完整任务与结果正确性
categories.applicability: User task has a defined business result or downstream effect
categories.limits: Input, operation, wait and business readback required from applicable account, role and environment; screenshot or self pass is insufficient.

categories.title: 故障与恢复
categories.applicability: Task can fail, partially succeed, be cancelled, retried, resumed or undone
categories.limits: Label controlled fault injection and real-environment boundaries; retry cannot repeat paid actions or destructive side effects without existing authorization.

categories.title: 权限、隐私与操作后果
categories.applicability: Roles, private data, permission changes or consequential actions exist
categories.limits: Project authorization is authoritative; hidden controls do not prove backend protection. No new recipients, permissions or fees.

categories.title: 响应速度与资源
categories.applicability: UI timing, large data, resource growth or responsiveness affects tasks
categories.limits: Thresholds and device/data conditions require project or standard provenance; a lab run is not field telemetry.

categories.title: 动效、声音与媒体
categories.applicability: Motion, audio, video or timed media is present
categories.limits: Reduced motion, stop controls and subtitles need applicable platform operation and content judgment.

categories.title: 平台及系统衔接
categories.applicability: Supported browsers or system lifecycle, windows, files, clipboard, sharing or printing matter
categories.limits: Each declared native platform needs its own host, build, device and adapter; web simulation and interface tests do not close native gaps.

categories.title: 复杂内容及专用交互
categories.applicability: Canvas, chart, editor, terminal, game, voice or spatial interaction exists
categories.limits: Use project semantics and dedicated input drivers; missing DOM or readable interface remains a coverage gap.

sourceRules.limits: Literal IDs in one static document only; templates need the project parser or runtime DOM.
Positive tabindex violates the selected default APG focus-order convention; project keyboard interaction still requires execution.
Requires explicit alt on literal img; empty alt is valid for decorative images, content quality needs review.
Checks native label association and explicit accessible names; correct label meaning and real input still require project verification.
Requires intentional HTML button type; submit remains legitimate and state or side effects still need actual interaction.
